page.layout: One page of text in a narrow centred column, with a running head at the top; no margin notes; a signature-like mark at the lower right corner.

main_text.p: rent componendo, nunc agitarentur corrumpendo, &c. Experimentum defumitur ab arte, quæ si aliqua naturæ opera solo corporum motu efficere potest, argumento est, naturam quoque eon simili ratione in omnibus operari.

page.notes: The text is set as a short indented block; the lines are broken at line ends with printed hyphens (de-, argu-, natu-, ratio-, opera-). The line "eon" and the cut "con," in "naturam quoque con-simili" are as far as legible; "ne" and "in omnibus" run on in the block. The end of the page carries a small ornamental flourish after "operari" and a bold mark at the lower right, which I could not read as a letter. Some words in the middle lines ("quoque eon," "aliqua") are slightly blurred; the reading "eon" in particular is uncertain. The printed running head reads "Prima Pars" in italic.
